'''Jacore Town''' (Japanese: '''ジャコールタウン''' ''Jackal Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]], which appeared in ''[[XY111|Unlocking Some Respect!]]''. It is located between [[Couriway Town]] and [[Snowbelle City]]. It has a jewelry exhibit.  

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were walking through Jacore Town when {{an|Serena}} came across an advertisement for a jewelry exhibit that was being held in the town. After Serena told the others about it, {{an|Bonnie}} became excited about it along with Serena. Ash, seeing how eager the two girls were to go and see the exhibit, told them that they should all go and see the exhibit, as a detour on their trip to [[Gloire City]].
